_comment: NVIDIA B100 (Blackwell, 2x GB100 die, 700W air-cooled SXM) single-accelerator HAT twin. RB-05: backing HBM3e -> L2 -> shared -> reg -> compute leaf. Dual-die presented as one logical GPU (10 TB/s NV-HBI). Load-bearing memory/compute/capacity = GOLD (multi-source); PE-internal (SM cut, clock, L2, matrix tile, HBM energy) = SILVER/BRONZE (no B100-specific NVIDIA die breakdown).

provenance.source: cudocompute Blackwell breakdown; wccftech; Wikipedia Blackwell; Spheron -- 192GB HBM3e, 8TB/s over 8192-bit bus. energy 5.0/6.5 pJ/B and line 32B are BRONZE estimates (NVIDIA does not publish HBM3e access energy or B100 burst granularity; anchored to H100 HBM3 7 pJ/B / 32B).

DISPUTED: chipsandcheese/emergentmind cluster around 96MB (8x8MB slices, 4 partitions/die) or 126MB; authored 100MB not corroborated. Adopted 96MB (=100663296) as best-corroborated. Bandwidth 1.0e13 inherited from H100 (Blackwell likely higher; estimate).

228 KB shared/L1 per SM (NVIDIA Blackwell architecture docs; up from Hopper 192KB config). Blackwell adds a separate 256KB Tensor Memory (TMEM) NOT modeled as the reuse tier here. Per-SM BW 3.34e13 scaled from H100 (estimate). x148 SMs.
256KB register file / 2.0e14 bps inherited from H100 GH100 SM; B100-specific not published.

Device dense BF16 = 1.8 PFLOP/s is GOLD (cudocompute; exxact; semianalysis; sits below B200 measured ~1.93 PFLOP/s exactly as the 700W bin implies). per_instance_mac_s = 1.8e15/2/148 = 6.081e12 (derived, SILVER). instances=148 (74 enabled/die x2; B100 shares B200 SM config per chipsandcheese/arXiv:2512.02189; a 132-SM figure also circulates -> SILVER). clock 1.837e9 = third-party B100 boost (axiomgaming DB); authored derived 1.43GHz rejected in favor of measured, BRONZE (NVIDIA publishes no official B100 clock). matrix_unit [16,8,16] = legacy warp-level PTX mma.sync tile used as systolic proxy for comparability with the H100 baseline; Blackwell 5th/6th-gen tcgen05.mma uses far larger native tiles (up to 256x256x16, 2-SM) -> BRONZE, understates true tile.
provenance.sanity: 6.081e12 x 148 x 2 = 1.7998e15 ~ 1.8 PFLOP/s; 1.8x H100 0.99 PFLOP/s, same order.

mma_isa.name: tcgen05.mma (native, not modeled as systolic shape)

provenance.source: 700W air-cooled B100 bin (Viperatech; cudocompute); 208B transistors (104B/die x2); NV-HBI 10 TB/s die-to-die. NVLink5 1.8 TB/s omitted (single-accelerator convention: no fabric level).

arch_note: Standard dual-die HBM GPU presented as one logical accelerator. 700W B100 bin shares GB100 silicon with 1000W B200; hits 1.8 PFLOP/s dense BF16 (vs B200 ~2.25/measured ~1.93) at a lower clock/same SM config. Load-bearing capacity/BW/device-peak are GOLD; SM-cut, clock, L2, matrix tile, and HBM access energy are SILVER/BRONZE (no NVIDIA B100-specific die breakdown).
